scope: Descriptive checks of archived records, not new inference or semantic validation

main.interpretation: Recorded track stops; not a ground-truth function-matching failure rate. Raw records precede endpoint-specific overload/exposure handling.

random.interpretation: Recorded track stops; not a ground-truth function-matching failure rate. Raw records precede endpoint-specific overload/exposure handling.

requirements: Name function explicitly; no cross-claim pronouns
extraction.interpretation: Different-family extraction/count and retyping checks, not repeated-run reliability, aligned extraction precision/recall, or human truth. Equal counts do not imply identical facts.

cross_family.meaning: Sum of recorded client request elapsed times only; not end-to-end wall time, developer effort, GPU utilization, historical runtime, or monetary cost.

runtime_limitations: Fresh runtime differs from unknown archived weight identity
Condition totals have different generation/control/exposure mixes; no clean per-touch cost comparison or refresh-policy benefit is identified

matching_rule.fallback: Unique new same-name candidate in same file, text SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.7
matching_rule.unknown: No independently labeled matching-error rate; unaccepted matches lead to censoring rather than a contradiction event
